references.title: Server-side field validation and OpenAPI v3

limitations: This tool does not connect to a cluster and cannot know installed API versions, CRDs, admission policies, namespaces, RBAC, quotas, defaults or live state.
It is not full Kubernetes OpenAPI schema validation and does not prove that kubectl apply will succeed.
Security and readiness findings are bounded review signals, not universal policy decisions; workload context may justify different settings.
